# WO-101: Correct the privacy promise on the home and Safety pages (WR-70)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel: docs/vendor/CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: the interactive Codex session that opened the agent channel (CODEX-001)

## Goal
The website says "Your details stay on your computer." That is too absolute: a removal request sends the person's details to the one site it asks (ROADMAP section 1, corrected 2026-11-07). Reword every occurrence in the live v3 site so it is exact and still calm, for example:
"Your details are stored only on your computer. They go out only in a removal request you approve, sent straight to that one site."
Keep the trust message strong and plain (docs/POSITIONING.md); never say "never leaves", "100%" or "guarantee".

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- No page in the built site (web/dist) contains "Your details stay on your computer" or another absolute claim that details never leave the computer.
- The home page, the Safety page and the FAQ answer "Where does my information go?" carry the corrected wording, consistently.
- The legacy v2 templates (site_src/templates/) get the same wording, so a rollback stays honest; `tools/build_site.py --check` still passes after the owner rebuilds site/.
- A new test asserts the old phrase is absent from the built pages and the new wording is present on home, /safety/ and the FAQ.
- `pnpm build`, `pnpm check` and `python scripts/content_check.py dist` (from web/) pass; no new JavaScript; the CSP is unchanged.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)

- web/src/pages/safety/index.astro

The illustration web/src/art/sections/safety-local.svg (tell me if its text needs changing), every other page, components, styles, tokens, site/ (the owner rebuilds it), and all in-house areas in docs/VENDOR.md.
